lanes.summary: The diff perfectly implements the requirements of PMAT-2154. It successfully enumerates and checks all 20 `xpile_meta_hir::Type` variants in a new `index_of` helper, which relies on exhaustive pattern matching without wildcards to ensure compile-time failure if new variants are added. The 7 payload-carrying variants (Dict, List, Set, Tuple, Optional, Struct, Ptr) are explicitly constructed and passed into `payload_variants_have_no_abi_slot` to assert that they yield `None` from `c_abi_type(ty)` (which ensures they receive no ABI slot). To prevent CBMC timeouts from dropping recursive `Box<Type>`, `std::mem::forget` is correctly applied. The required updates to documentation (Kani harnesses incremented from 103 to 104, stratum-vote artifacts incremented from 592 to 593) are accurately reflected across the specifications as required by `claims_drift`.

Diff refutation check for PMAT-2154 passed. The diff implements all acceptance criteria of PMAT-2154 and nothing forbidden: it extends real_ffi_abi_slot.rs to check all 20 variants of xpile_meta_hir::Type across two harnesses (13 payload-free via abi_slot_matches_the_c_type_and_the_wrapper and 7 payload-carrying via payload_variants_have_no_abi_slot with concrete inner types and mem::forget to bound CBMC drop glue). index_of provides an exhaustive 20-arm match with no wildcard. Shipped tables pass (0.9s and 2.2s), and the planted mutant (Type::Struct => c_int) fails payload_variants_have_no_abi_slot. Spec tallies are updated from 103 to 104 (and 592 to 593 stratum votes) as required by claims_drift.rs. No gates are weakened and no extraneous changes are present.

findings.claim: `index_of` defines an exhaustive 20-arm match with no wildcard over `xpile_meta_hir::Type`, mapping variants 0..=12 to payload-free scalars and 13..=19 to payload-carrying types, turning any future 21st variant into a compile error.
`check_variant` asserts `index_of(&ty) == i`, ensuring the loop in `abi_slot_matches_the_c_type_and_the_wrapper` covers all 13 payload-free variants without omission or repetition.

`payload_variants_have_no_abi_slot` instantiates all seven payload-carrying variants (Dict, List, Set, Tuple, Optional, Struct, Ptr) with concrete inner types, asserts `c_abi_type(ty).is_none()`, validates bidirectional index consistency, sets bitmask tracking for all 7 variants (`seen == 0b111_1111`), and bounds CBMC unwinding by leaking via `std::mem::forget`.

Planted mutant documentation records that adding `Type::Struct(_) => Some("::std::os::raw::c_int")` to `c_abi_type` turns `payload_variants_have_no_abi_slot` FAILED with "a payload variant got an ABI slot", satisfying PROPERTY 7 of `proof_seam_witness.rs`.

`enum Type` in `crates/xpile-meta-hir/src/lib.rs` defines exactly 20 variants (13 payload-free scalars/tokens and 7 payload-carrying types including Ptr), fully partitioned and checked across the two Kani harnesses.
Kani BMC harness tally updated from 103 to 104 in `docs/specifications/audit-design.md`, satisfying `crates/xpile/tests/claims_drift.rs`.
Kani BMC harness tally updated from 103 to 104 and stratum-vote artifact count updated from 592 to 593 in `docs/specifications/sub/kaizen-fleet.md`.
Kani harness count updated from 103 to 104 in `docs/specifications/sub/sprint-6day-2026-07-26.md`.
PMAT-2154 is registered in `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` with acceptance criteria strictly matching the ticket requirements.

PMAT-2154 entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` documents the coverage of all 20 meta-HIR types, CBMC drop-glue bounding via `mem::forget`, verification run times (0.9s and 2.2s), mutant falsification, and specification tally updates.
